research_notes.name: Outbound AI Investment Notification Desk
research_notes.finding: US Treasury Oct 7 2026 confirms first OISP $200,000 penalty against Amidi. Kharon explicitly markets OISP compliance screening: direct overlap in same investment buyer and OISP controls, though notification case-file workflow not fully established. Zero-direct-competitor claim invalid. Official US Treasury ONS is the filing destination, so a third-party product should prepare reviewable evidence rather than claim to replace official filing.
research_notes.next: Verify original US penalty and Treasury rule; search specialized outbound-investment compliance vendors.
research_notes.mvp_constraint: Manual pre-filing decision log and exportable evidence packet; no automated government filing.

research_notes.name: AI Materials Recipe-to-Lab Handoff
research_notes.finding: SciNote ELN already provides experiment/protocol versioning, task assignment, linked results, electronic signatures and audit trail; substantial same-customer same-job workflow overlap. This is a credible direct global competitor, not merely adjacent. Labguru also provides templated experiment procedures and result records; second serious direct overlap. IDBS Polar officially advertises experiment versioning and ELN/LES/LIMS; Turkish language availability is not proof of Turkish vendor origin. Lims.science Turkish localization has broad laboratory workflows but exact materials synthesis fit unverified.
research_notes.next: Check Labguru, SciNote, MaterialsZone and Turkey lab software vendors.

research_notes.name: Agent Sandbox Readiness Desk
research_notes.finding: E2B and Daytona are confirmed sandbox runtime providers and adjacent infrastructure; neither cited source establishes a standalone sandbox assessment evidence desk. Further direct search required. Northflank publishes a detailed security evaluation evidence matrix and Gamut provides an AI agent assurance checklist; checklist-only differentiation is weak. Additional agent security assessment vendors Oktsec and Gamut Assure may overlap directly with assessment and evidence workflows. Primary vendor pages show direct workflow overlap: Oktsec agent policy/audit evidence and Gamut agent control assessment and reviewable evidence. Gamut's platform and Oktsec audit-evidence pages substantiate same-buyer assessment and evidence overlap; do not claim this market is vacant.
research_notes.next: Search sandbox assessment checklist/evidence platforms specifically.

research_notes.name: Text Watermark Rollout QA Matrix
research_notes.finding: OpenAI original confirms Oct 5 EU phased rollout and global API opt-in. Text detector restricted to approved researchers; proposed MVP must not promise automatic watermark verification or require restricted detector API. Official OpenAI API docs confirm text provenance verification restricted to approved organizations. Hawzu and Prooflane provide release-readiness/evidence workflows but not confirmed text-watermark-specific workflow; classify as adjacent pending direct research.
research_notes.next: Research watermark rollout test management direct competitors.
research_notes.mvp_constraint: Manual model/region watermark feature inventory, test evidence and release signoff only; no automatic text watermark detection, no restricted detector API, no paid integration.
